x 16 336 0 0 0 12 A: LDR and 10 kOhm -> GPIO 4 (ADC)
x 120 288 0 0 0 12 firmware: dark below 1.38 V, light above 1.86 V
x 88 472 0 0 0 12 PIR OUT: hold = motion
x 80 720 0 0 0 12 P: 45k = INPUT_PULLDOWN in the ESP32
x 80 752 0 0 0 12 firmware timer: while OUT is HIGH the switch keeps 100 uF full (lastMotionMs = now);
x 80 768 0 0 0 12 after OUT falls the resistor drains it, 1.0 V is reached after 15 s -> TIMEOUT
x 448 96 0 0 0 12 firmware rule: on = dark AND motion, off = TIMEOUT OR light
x 448 112 0 0 0 12 the NOR latch is the 'on' variable: room light switches it off at once
x 560 448 0 0 0 12 light = NOT DARK; TIMEOUT or light resets the latch
x 928 512 0 0 0 12 B: BC547 stage, 3.3 V -> 5 V on IN
